title: Blender MCP plus Fable 5.1 builds city mesh from equirectangular panorama
summary: Japanese X post showing Blender MCP with Fable 5.1 building a dense city model from an equirectangular panorama in one shot. Author estimates manual equivalent at three person-days of work.
question_it_answers: Can Blender MCP plus Fable 5.1 reconstruct a detailed city mesh from a panorama image in one pass?

claims.text: Blender MCP with Fable 5.1 built a high-detail city model from an equirectangular panorama in one attempt.
claims.evidence: 右のエクイレクタングラー方式の都市パノラマ画像をリソースとして都市を構築させたところ、一発でこの情報量のモデルが完成。
claims.subject: image-to-3d-world
